storyBody: Tsukimizaka is a little hillside town by the sea. Fifth-grader Koharu Hoshikawa is a true genius at forgetting things — something different every single day.
One evening, as the town's sunset chime rings out at 5 o'clock, Koharu hears a tiny voice: "...So cold. Somebody, please find me..."

Following the voice to the top of the hill, she discovers a mysterious red-brick building that holds a hundred years of lost things: the Lost-and-Found Hall. There she meets Pocke, the spirit of a single red mitten.

Koharu can hear the voices of lost things. Together with proud honor student Ayame, her easily-scared childhood friend Taiga, and the mysterious new transfer student Kanata, she takes on Phantom Thief Midnight, who steals people's most precious memories. Who is the thief behind the mask? The cozy, magical case files of the Lost-and-Found Detectives begin!

features.title: A new lost-thing mystery every episode
features.text: A hairpin, a music score, a soccer ball, a single rain boot... Listen to the voices of lost things and find the feelings of the people who lost them.

features.title: Who is Phantom Thief Midnight?
features.text: "Tonight, I shall take your most precious memory." The thief who leaves calling cards hides a secret no one knows.

features.title: Where is Pocke's other half?
features.text: Pocke was born from a single mitten. Who owned the other one — and where is it now?

characters.name: Koharu Hoshikawa
characters.catch: Leave that lost thing to me — I'll bring it home!
characters.desc: A cheerful, big-hearted "genius of forgetting." She forgets her own things all the time, but she's the first to notice when someone has lost a feeling. During the 5 o'clock twilight, she can hear lost things speak. Loves roasted sweet potatoes and the melon bread from her family's bakery.

characters.name: Pocke
characters.desc: A palm-sized spirit born from a single red mitten. Greedy for snacks, a little cheeky, and quick to cry. When Pocke slips onto Koharu's left hand, she can see the glowing "threads of memory" that lead to a lost thing's owner. Pocke is always searching for its missing other half.

characters.name: Ayame Kujo
characters.desc: A perfectionist honor student with a sharp tongue and a soft heart. Never without her detective notebook and fountain pen. Where Koharu sees with her heart, Ayame sees with her head. Secretly adores cute things (she silently screamed the first time she saw Pocke) and is terrified of ghosts.

characters.name: Taiga Inukai
characters.catch: Leave it to me! ...W-WAAAH, IT'S HERE!
characters.desc: Koharu's loud, big-hearted childhood friend. His nose is as good as a dog's — he can guess the school lunch menu from the hallway. He's scared of anything spooky, but he's always the first to run in when a friend needs him.

characters.name: Kanata Yomi
characters.desc: A quiet, cool transfer student with silver hair. He carries an antique silver pocket watch stopped at exactly 5 o'clock. He's only gentle with little kids and cats — and for some reason, he can't ride a bike. No one knows his secret.

characters.name: Phantom Thief Midnight
characters.desc: A phantom thief who appears at twilight and steals people's most precious memories, turning them into black glass marbles. Strangely, he always leaves behind a clue for getting them back. Who is he — and why?

characters.name: Shiori
characters.catch: Oh my, what a lovely guest.
characters.desc: The keeper of the Lost-and-Found Hall, where a hundred years of lost things sleep. She wears a Taisho-era kimono and hakama with a ring of brass keys at her waist. Gentle and dreamy, but sometimes startlingly sharp. Loves tea and sweets.

episodes.title: The Sunset Chime and the Talking Mitten
episodes.teaser: A tiny voice at the 5 o'clock chime leads Koharu to a mysterious hall on the hilltop — and to Pocke, a red mitten spirit.

episodes.title: The Transfer Student and the Stopped Watch
episodes.teaser: The day silver-haired Kanata transfers in, Phantom Thief Midnight sends a calling card. His target: Ms. Mori's most precious memory.

episodes.title: Ayame's Detective Notebook
episodes.teaser: The class money has vanished — and Koharu is the prime suspect! Ayame's logic and the voices of lost things uncover the truth.

episodes.title: Taiga and Grandpa's Ball
episodes.teaser: Taiga lost the signed soccer ball his grandpa gave him. The only clue leads to the one place he fears most: the Haunted Tunnel.

episodes.title: The Single Boot on a Rainy Day
episodes.teaser: On a cold rainy day, a little girl cries over a lost rain boot. And for some reason, quiet Kanata tags along.

episodes.title: Ayame's Birthday and the Vanished Promise
episodes.teaser: Midnight's next target is Ayame's mother's memory. To save a birthday promise, the detectives race to the hospital at night!

episodes.title: The True Face of Phantom Thief Midnight
episodes.teaser: A single silver hair left in Koharu's hand. On the sunset hilltop, she comes face to face with the truth.

episodes.title: The Secret of the Lost-and-Found Hall
episodes.teaser: A story from a station a hundred years ago, and a basement sealed with chains. What is the lonely shadow hiding in the hall?

episodes.title: The School Play and the Star Lantern
episodes.teaser: As the curtain rises on "The Snow Queen," the whole town's memories are in danger. Everyone's feelings transform the star magnifying glass!

episodes.title: No One Remembers Kanata
episodes.teaser: The next morning, Kanata's desk is gone. Only Koharu and Pocke remember him...

episodes.title: Into the Land of Twilight
episodes.teaser: A land of forgotten things where the sunset never ends. Koharu goes to bring someone precious home.

episodes.title: That Mitten, I'll Always Remember
episodes.teaser: Five years ago, at the winter festival, at 5 o'clock — the most important promise Koharu forgot. The detectives' final case.
